reviews.title: Great quality would buy from vendor again
reviews.body: The good: this is a very affordable sturdy outdoor furniture set. I couldn't see myself paying as much or more for outdoor occasional furniture and this fulfilled my need for looks, sturdiness, quality and price.Looks: look at the pics. This set is really nice looking, not bulky but not flimsy and small either.Size: It fits well on my 13x16 deck leaving room for 2 banquet tables a popcorn machine and a grill during a recent party.Quality: I had no issue with pieces of wicker coming off and they have been out in the weather sun, rain and some early fall chill (40 degrees) with no problems. The bumper on the glass came off and I put it back on. Complaints about furniture sliding apart was not an issue. I ordered the clips separately and it was a waste since my pieces pretty much stay put but I waited to late to return. Cushions I keep in the house when not using them but they do tend to fall over the tops. Not sure if my daughter installed them right but they are nice and comfortable. Longevity well if you don't hear from me by Summer 2021 they are still working and made it thru a Jersey winter. If not I will update and complain big time.Price: these are much more affordable then anything I can find locally at the big box stores and other discount reatailers.Assembly: wasn't too bad. Much easier then Ikea furniture. Make sure you pay attention to the directions. They came in several large boxes and the tools needed were provided in each box for that set. As someone familiar with manufacturing techniques this vendor executes their plans for this item well. Basically depending on which set you order depends on how many boxes you get. So the vendor (like Ikea does) can mix and match the boxes coming up with a variety of products they sell while keeping their cost low.This was well worth the money and if this hold up well over winter and middle of next summer left out in the elements (cushions indoors) I will look at some other pieces to purchase or even gift to my sister and daughter who are both buying a home soon

reviews.title: Versatile & affordable, great for large spaces.
reviews.body: We have an awkwardly large covered patio space that already has a dining set, and we wanted a large neutral sofa or sectional to fill the rest of the space without breaking the bank. This is perfect for what we needed. It arrived within a week in 3 separate boxes. I was able to lift them alone when they arrived and I'm a petite gal.The cushions and frame are better quality than we expected for the price, and we were pleasantly surprised to find the two red throw pillows came with it as well. We'll probably get another one somewhere to balance it out how we have it arranged. We love how you can arrange this set in a number of ways-- we ended up making a big corner sectional, but could easily switch it up. The individual pieces of the sofa are free-standing and don't attach to one another, but so far we haven't had sliding at all. The cushions attach to the sofa frame which is also a plus. The overall effect is pretty classy and looks solid. As long as you understand you're buying a $400 sectional when they can run upwards of $1k, you won't be disappointed.I saw a few people say it's a pain to assemble in the other reviews, but honestly, if you're used to putting together IKEA furniture or other flat pack things, this is pretty straightforward. All one type of bolt with 3 allen wrenches included so it can be a 2- or 3-person job, and the pieces are labeled and visual instructions are clear. It took us about an hour and a half to get it up, and it came with a couple extra bolts and washers just in case. Everything fit together quite well and we didn't have to force it.Overall, for the price, easily 5 stars. We love our new sofa!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 7 March 2020
reviews.author: Maggie

reviews.title: Really good quality for the price
reviews.body: Overall this is a good set of patio or deck furniture for the price. Some people complain it’s small like ‘children’s playhouse’ furniture, when I opened the box I was afraid it would be way to small. After assembling it all and sitting on it it’s a good enough height, it could be an inch or two taller but it’s not really as bad as some have complained. The backs of the seats are upright 90 degree angle which is a little Uncomfortable, but this isn’t meant to be lounged in all day like an indoor couch. My only real complaint is the pads for the back of the seats don’t attach to anything and blow off with a heavy wind. Assembly isn’t difficult it’s just time consuming, but once assembled it feels strong and sturdy. Over all I’m happy with it, it’s beautiful looking and I’ve gotten tons of compliments on it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 3 April 2020
reviews.author: Ryan G

reviews.title: Family loves this set!
reviews.body: Very nice set, especially for the price! I put the set together myself without an issue. I recommend using a power driver with an extension attachment and a Hex Head Allen Wrench from a drill bit set. This will make for a quicker assembly. Use the Allen Wrench provided in the set for tightening in hard to reach places. The set came in three boxes and two different deliveries. The boxes I received included all that was needed for each piece of the set, so I only had to wait for two more chairs in the second delivery and was able to enjoy the chairs and table I had already received until they arrived. The seating is low, but we prefer that on the deck. The seat cushions come with toggles that can be tucked into the woven areas on the side to keep them from moving around, but the back cushions do tend to slide around quite a bit. It rained one day and the cushions soaked through, so now we store them in a shed when we know heavy rains are coming so we don't have to wait days for them to dry out again. The seating is comfortable enough, but the backs are low. I love being able to move the seats around easily and rearrange the area as needed. I'm so happy I ordered this set. I hope they last a few years at least!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 2 June 2020
reviews.author: Curious Cat

reviews.title: Some of the cushions changed color within FOUR days!
reviews.body: The price was right and it was fairly easy to assemble (although very intimidating because it came in so many piecses!).  It's sturdy and comfortable enough.However, it's only been assembled and outside for FOUR DAYS and some of the cushions have completely changed color.  You can see where the back cushion hid the two cushions from the sun.  What's weird is that not all of the cushions have changed color - just two seats and three backs out of twelve cushions.  This looks like an old set that's been in the sun for a few years - not a few days!
